title: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable…
description: The WP Job Portal WordPress plugin up to version 2.7.0 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'degreetitle' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. The plugin allows self-registration, enabling any visitor to create an account capable of exploiting this vulnerability.
